Care Veterinary Center (CARE) is a specialty and emergency veterinary hospital in Frederick, Maryland. Our veterinarians and technicians offer exceptional, compassionate care with superior client service. Our entire staff of doctors, technicians and care specialists are committed to treating each of our patients as if they were their own pet. 

At CARE we have a highly trained and qualified staff of board-certified specialists and veterinarians to treat your animals. Specialists in surgery, orthopedic surgery, internal medicine, rehabilitation, cardiology and pain management are available.  Veterinary specialists are available by appointment weekdays and are always on-call for emergencies. They have all received extensive training and can handle any situation or emergency that comes to our hospital.

Emergency Veterinarians are available for Urgent and Emergency care evenings, overnights, weekends and holidays.
